stem_book: The heat of combustion of solid benzoic acid at constant volume is −321.30 kJ at 27°C. The heat of combustion at constant pressure is (−321.30 kJ − xR J), with R in J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹. The value of x is ______.
reason: Printed '(−321.30 − xR) kJ' gives x = 0.15 if R is in J; the official/printed answer 150 needs the xR term in joules, so the units are made explicit.
work: C₆H₅COOH(s) + (15/2)O₂ → 7CO₂ + 3H₂O(l): Δng = −1/2; ΔH = ΔU + ΔngRT = −321.30 kJ − (1/2)·300·R = −321.30 kJ − 150R J
